methodNote: Ranked from public news, scientific coverage, and program outcomes over ~2–3 years; refreshed as new stories arrive.

groups.name: Instituto Argonauta
groups.focus: Beach monitoring, wildlife rescue/rehab, marine litter, cetacean response
groups.summary: Daily PMP-BS coverage of ~218 Litoral Norte beaches, CRETA rehab, litter bulletins through 2025, and documented whale disentanglement off Ilhabela (2023).
groups.scoreNote: Highest continuous operational footprint on the SP side of the corridor; outcomes are operational and incident-documented.

groups.name: Fundação Projeto Tamar (Ubatuba)
groups.focus: Sea turtle feeding-area monitoring, bycatch mitigation, rehab, education
groups.summary: Long-running Camburi floating-weir monitoring with measurable returns (128 turtles Oct 2024–Jul 2025) plus rehab/museum outreach in Ubatuba.
groups.scoreNote: Strong time series and countable bycatch returns; national brand with a concrete local base.

groups.name: Projeto Baleia Jubarte
groups.focus: Humpback research, photo-ID, SE corridor science, responsible whale watching
groups.summary: Expedição Sudeste 2024 surveyed Paraty→Arraial (223 humpbacks, 124 photo-IDs) and trained community tourism operators in Arraial.
groups.scoreNote: Corridor-scale science and tourism influence; SE work is seasonal relative to Abrolhos core.

groups.name: Instituto PROSHARK
groups.focus: Shark/ray telemetry, aggregation science, MPA-relevant data
groups.summary: Angra-based (founded 2024) satellite/acoustic monitoring of Ilha Grande Bay sharks; peer-reviewed tagging papers and ISRA-linked Piraquara science.
groups.region: Angra dos Reis / Baía da Ilha Grande
groups.scoreNote: High scientific leverage for a young NGO; shares the Piraquara story with Mar Urbano/IBRACON—do not over-attribute discovery.

groups.name: Instituto Mar Urbano / Tubarões da BIG (IBRACON)
groups.focus: Shark aggregation monitoring, public science communication, fisher engagement
groups.summary: Documented 105+ blacktip aggregations (2023) and 113+ (2025) at Piraquara; tied to ISRA designation coverage with ICMBio partners.
groups.region: Baía da Ilha Grande / Angra dos Reis
groups.scoreNote: Best public field documentation of the Ilha Grande shark aggregation; complements PROSHARK papers.

groups.name: Instituto Albatroz (PMP Lagos)
groups.focus: Beach monitoring, seabird/turtle rescue and rehab
groups.summary: First PMP year (Jun 2024–Jun 2025): 569 animals found across 25 beaches; 55 rehabilitated releases from Araruama CRD.
groups.region: Cabo Frio, Búzios, Arraial do Cabo
groups.scoreNote: Clear quantitative outcomes; licensing-funded scale (not voluntary philanthropy alone).

groups.name: Programa Mar Sem Lixo (Fundação Florestal)
groups.focus: Fisher PES for marine litter removal, education, plastic data
groups.summary: SP government PSA program; phase-2 includes Ubatuba and São Sebastião; 32 t removed Jun 2022–Oct 2024 with 255 enrolled fishers.
groups.region: SP coast incl. Ubatuba & São Sebastião
groups.scoreNote: Government program, not an NGO; strong tonnage but only part of footprint is in this corridor.

groups.name: Projeto Ilhas do Rio (Instituto Mar Adentro)
groups.focus: Island biodiversity research, Hope Spot/MPA advocacy, cleanups
groups.summary: Mission Blue Hope Spot expanded 17k→57k ha (Apr 2024); Peças/Palmas surveys and a 30.3 kg Palmas cleanup documented.
groups.scoreNote: Strong advocacy/science on Rio islands; urban/east edge of the corridor rather than Angra–Ilhabela core.

groups.name: Projeto Costão Rochoso
groups.focus: Reef/rocky-shore monitoring, education, sustainable tourism training
groups.summary: Ongoing Lagos scientific dives (fish, corals, benthos); 2026 campaign in Búzios/Arraial/Cabo Frio with stated Costa Verde expansion.
groups.scoreNote: Solid monitoring/education program; fewer countable rescue/tonnage outcomes than PMP/Tamar.

groups.name: VIVA Instituto Verde Azul (Mantas de Ilhabela partner)
groups.summary: 2024 Ilhabela whale-season opening with Jubarte/Baleia à Vista; new oceanic manta photo-ID added to Manta Trust database (Jun 2024).
groups.scoreNote: Specialized local megafauna work; smaller operational scale than Argonauta/Tamar.

groups.name: Sea Shepherd Brasil (Ondas Limpas)
groups.focus: Underwater and beach plastic/ghost-gear cleanups, education
groups.summary: Documented 370 kg underwater litter removal at Praia da Longa, Ilha Grande (Apr 2024) with local association and Brigada Mirim.
groups.scoreNote: Verified event-based cleanup impact; not a permanent local research base.

groups.name: Brigada Mirim Ecológica da Ilha Grande
groups.focus: Youth education, recycling, community mariculture, reforestation
groups.summary: Recicla Ilha + Fazenda Marinha; Funbio/TAC Frade support (Nov 2024) for scallop mariculture; partner in Longa Limpa cleanup.
groups.scoreNote: Strong community/youth outcomes; marine work mixed with terrestrial livelihoods.

groups.name: Projeto Cetáceos da Costa Azul (ECoMAR/UFRJ)
groups.focus: Cetacean habitat use and vessel-interaction research
groups.summary: UFRJ lab project on cetaceans vs tourism/dive boats in Arraial, Cabo Frio, and Búzios; academic rather than rescue/cleanup scale.
groups.scoreNote: Clear geographic fit; thinner public outcome metrics in 2023–26 than operational NGOs above.
